notes.title: Steam Edition 1.45
notes.notes:
Today we have posted a new update for Battle Girls, this update makes some adjustments to the game files of Battle Girls in compliance with Steams new requirements on Censorship.

Whilst the game included no publicly visible adult content or illustrations, we did find some old dialogue sections from the adult version. Whilst not visible to players this update completely removes that content from the game files 'just in case'.

The Battle Girls game now fully complies with teams terms on pornographic content, as any suggestive material in the game is less explicit than the scenes featured in games like Witcher 3 which has fully uncensored sex scenes and nudity. This game does not include that and so should now meet Steams requirements. 

If you want to see how this might affect you and your game, more details can be found on our blog at website https://Dharker.Studio
